primary_source_verification.title: SCAFFOLD: Stochastic Controlled Averaging for Federated Learning
primary_source_verification.method: Opened the primary PDF directly; independently read Algorithm 1 and equations 3-5 from extracted text. Retained exact downloaded PDF bytes. No secondary source or appendix equation 19 used as the oracle.
locations: Appendix E Eq 19, PDF page 26, checked only as a counterexample
primary_source_verification.independent_inference: Telescoping the local updates gives ci_new=mean of used gradients for constant-rate vanilla SGD. Appendix 19 reverses c/ci in the displacement expression; g=0,c=2,ci=1,eta=.1 gives 2 rather than 0. This is independently disproved, not adopted.

bounded_design_checks.subject: Explicit F27 semantic fix and independent reference
bounded_design_checks.rationale: Both legacy numerical defects are explicitly repaired, with detached round snapshots and delta computed against old ci. The exact zero/nonzero SGD cases discriminate the wrong sign and wrong control formula. Independent exact arithmetic matches every supplied two-round value.

bounded_design_checks.subject: Actual optimizer LR, constant equal-rate groups and real update timing
bounded_design_checks.rationale: The real optimizer is the authority, with no .01/trainer.lr fallback. The fixed positive finite scalar boundary, equal groups mapped by parameter identity, round reset and pre-update rejection of a changed rate are specific. Normal and final updates must capture the executed rate before post-step hooks/schedulers can change it.
bounded_design_checks.baseline_evidence: optimizers.py:45-62 reads parameters.optimizer; composable.py:447 precedes optimizer creation at 481; before_step at 530 is only a microbatch hook; finalization at 605 has no before_step; post-optimizer hook at 564 precedes correction at 569.
bounded_design_checks.feasibility: Publishing context.state[optimizer] after creation is reachable without reordering on_train_start. The installed actual optimizer supports step pre-hooks, independently exercised once. The final-path pre-update capture remains mandatory implementation work under C02/A02/A04, not a defect deferred to variable-rate support.

bounded_design_checks.subject: Parameter ownership, custom names, buffers and historical controls
bounded_design_checks.rationale: Removing name filtering and using optimizer-owned requires_grad parameters fixes theta and reordered groups. Missing gradients receive zero-gradient additive correction. Frozen/excluded parameters avoid corrections; excluded trainable controls remain unchanged with zero delta. Known historical buffer/frozen extras are projected, unknown/missing/shape/nonfinite controls fail, and inbound tensors are detached rather than mutated.
bounded_design_checks.baseline_evidence: scaffold_strategy.py:235-239 versus 332; scaffold_server.py:80-89 creates controls from the full state_dict and 66-68 assumes delta keys for every entry.

bounded_design_checks.subject: Completed-update K, final accumulation, K=0 and zero LR
bounded_design_checks.rationale: F08 supplies the actual completed-step contract. Windows 2 with 1/3/4 microbatches test K=1/2/2 and normalized tails, skipped steps and no duplicate finalize. A later empty round must retain ci and emit fresh zero delta. Zero/negative/nonfinite LR fails before an attempted update; max(1,K) is removed.

bounded_design_checks.subject: Logical-client controls, migration and successful worker return
bounded_design_checks.rationale: One strategy owns ci. F23 logical identity and F07 contained paths are explicit prerequisites. Canonical state wins; only exact same-client legacy paths can be imported, never client 0 for another ID. Reuse 1->2->1 and reconstruction are compared over multiple rounds. Parent ci and delta must come from the current successful child; missing/failed handoff or load/save cannot yield a stale successful outbound result.
bounded_design_checks.compatibility: Legacy dictionaries/files remain structurally loadable and original files retained. Corrected continuation intentionally differs numerically. Consistent fresh initialization is documented without a one-client reset or a full-restart promise.

bounded_design_checks.subject: Late payload context handoff and reused processor binding
bounded_design_checks.rationale: Each inbound extraction installs current detached server c directly in the active trainer context. Reused processors rebind to the current trainer/client; omitted or malformed example c clears stale data and fails. The optional standalone zero-control fallback does not excuse missing controls in the federated example. A06 tests the actual order and consumed/emitted state, in both direct and shipped spawn paths.

bounded_design_checks.subject: Population denominator, model weighting and validation before commit
bounded_design_checks.rationale: Controls retain the 1/N population update while model aggregation retains existing sample weights. Unequal-count behavior is labeled a SCAFFOLD-derived extension, with no weighted-objective/convergence claim. The oracle distinguishes x=1.19 from uniform x=1 and gives c=2/3. Required deltas and all control keys must validate before either model/control commit; malformed payloads cannot be silently dropped.
bounded_design_checks.feasibility: The example weights_received hook runs before model mutation and can validate/stage the complete control update. Checking only weights_aggregated is insufficient; existing C08/A08 already require early rejection. No general server-base redesign is necessary for this bounded contract.

bounded_design_checks.subject: Honest SGD reference, momentum/Adam extension and V2 compatibility
bounded_design_checks.rationale: The shipped momentum=.9/config values are preserved. Plain fixed-rate SGD with momentum/weight_decay=0 and maximize=false supplies the strict gradient reference. Other retained optimizers use the explicitly defined post-optimizer subtractive extension and warn once per run; A09 checks raw-optimizer composition instead of falsely claiming mean-gradient equivalence. Exported V2/constructor remain as corrected Option II compatibility, including the accumulation tail. True Option I is a feature deferral rather than a reason to keep the broken implementation.

bounded_design_checks.subject: Mandatory public docs, phase ownership and F20 exception
bounded_design_checks.rationale: Corrected formulas, actual delta transport, fixed-rate limits, optimizer/model-weighting limits, legacy numerical discontinuity and removal of blanket convergence claims are mandatory before Phase 2C/Phase 2 closure. Exact SCAFFOLD example/docs paths are reserved from Phase 4/5. F20 legacy unsquared-L2 default and l1 behavior remain independently preserved; no squared-FedProx migration is inferred.
bounded_design_checks.baseline_evidence: Public SCAFFOLD section lines12-17; plan-addendum.json F20 policy; design decision.preserve, C10 and implementation_handoff.
bounded_design_checks.user_model_policy: Overall 2C ownership names the phase task. C owns code/tests/docstrings. A fresh root-assigned Astra writing agent authors standalone README/public prose from C implementation facts, followed by independent review. This user-authorized handoff satisfies the ownership contract and must occur before Phase 2 closure, not be deferred to later docs phases.

bounded_design_checks.subject: Finite acceptance, dependencies and unnecessary scope
bounded_design_checks.rationale: A01-A10 are behavior-specific and discriminating, not helper-derived or parse-only checks. The deterministic synthetic config-based smoke produces real client gradients/deltas with actual counts 2/6/4 and K=2; one batch per epoch is reachable through the baseline loader. Direct/spawn qualification and F07/F08/F23 integrated review are mandatory. Deferred variable rates, true Option I, new model weighting, full restart, GPU and benchmarks do not excuse known supported-path defects. Authentication, transport, unrelated algorithms and general framework redesign are excluded.
bounded_design_checks.ownership: Root accepts the exact design, serializes any necessary shared handoff, authorizes the original 2C implementer, assigns the prose handoff and records the Phase 4 receipt. No extra user-permission detour is required. A10 uses supported locked 3.13 and focused available 3.14 evidence without claiming whole-stack support.

executed_checks.baseline_probe_isolation: Compiled the exact git object and patched only its Config accessor in the probe process; the pickle output stayed in owned scratch. No root fixture or candidate code used.
